1.2.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I have no pain at the moment.|1///1 The pain is very mild at the moment.|2///2 The pain is moderate at the moment.|3///3 The pain is fairly severe at the moment.|4///4 The pain is very severe at the moment.|5///5 The pain is the worst imaginable at the moment.

1.3.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I can look after myself normally without causing additional pain.|1///1 I can look after myself normally but it is very painful.|2///2 It is painful to look after myself and I am slow and careful.|3///3 I need some help but manage most of my personal care.|4///4 I need help every day in most aspects of my personal care.|5///5 I do not get dressed, I wash with difficulty and stay in bed.

1.4.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I can lift heavy weights without additional pain.|1///1 I can lift heavy weights but it gives me additional pain.|2///2 Pain prevents me from lifting heavy weights off the floor but I can manage if they are conveniently positioned, e.g. on a table.| 3///3 Pain prevents me from lifting heavy weights but I can manage light to medium weights if they are conveniently positioned.|4///4 I can only lift very light weights.|5///5 I cannot lift or carry anything at all.

1.5.field_constraint_data: 0///0 Pain does not prevent me from walking any distance.|1///1 Pain prevents me from walking more than one mile.|2///2 Pain prevents me from walking more than a quarter of a mile.|3///3 Pain prevents me from walking more than 100 yards.|4///4 I can only walk using a cane or crutches.|5///5 I am in bed most of the time and have to crawl to the toilet.

1.6.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I can sit in any chair as long as I like.|1///1 I can sit in my favorite chair as long as I like.|2///2 Pain prevents me from sitting for more than 1 hour.|3///3 Pain prevents me from sitting for more than half an hour.|4///4 Pain prevents me from sitting for more than 10 minutes.|5///5 Pain prevents me from sitting at all.

1.7.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I can stand as long as I want without additional pain.|1///1 I can stand as long as I want but it gives me additional pain.|2///2 Pain prevents me from standing for more than 1 hour.|3///3 Pain prevents me from standing for more than half an hour.|4///4 Pain prevents me from standing for more than 10 minutes.|5///5 Pain prevents me from standing at all.

1.8.field_constraint_data: 0///0 My sleep is never interrupted by pain.|1///1 My sleep is occasionally interrupted by pain.|2///2 Because of pain I have less than 6 hours sleep.|3///3 Because of pain I have less than 4 hours sleep.|4///4 Because of pain I have less than 2 hours sleep.|5///5 Pain prevents me from sleeping at all.

1.9.field_constraint_data: 0///0 My sex life is normal and causes no additional pain.|1///1 My sex life is normal but causes some additional pain.|2///2 My sex life is nearly normal but is very painful.|3///3 My sex life is severely restricted by pain.|4///4 My sex life is nearly non existent because of pain.|5///5 Pain prevents me from having any sex life at all.

1.10.field_constraint_data: 0///0 My social life is normal and causes me no additional pain.|1///1 My social life is normal but increases the degree of pain.|2///2 Pain has no significant effect on my social life apart from limiting my more energetic interests, e.g. sport, etc.|3///3 Pain has restricted my social life and I do not go out as often.|4///4 Pain has restricted my social life to home.|5///5 I have no social life because of pain.

1.11.field_constraint_data: 0///0 I can travel anywhere without pain.|1///1 I can travel anywhere but it gives me additional pain.|2///2 Pain is bad but I am able to manage trips over two hours.|3///3 Pain restricts me to trips of less than one hour.|4///4 Pain restricts me to short necessary trips of under 30 minutes.|5///5 Pain prevents me from traveling except to receive treatment.
